'''Cream of broccoli soup''' is a [[soup]] prepared with [[broccoli]], [[Stock (food)|stock]], and milk or [[cream]] as primary ingredients. Ingredient variations exist, as do vegan versions. It is also a commercially, mass-produced soup, often sold in cans. Several recipes use canned cream of broccoli soup as an ingredient,<ref name="BCT"/> such as its use with cooked chicken dishes and as a [[sauce]].<ref name="DN"/>
